description:
You are organizing a development project in your home directory at /home/user. In the directory /home/user/dev_project, there is a file named filenames.txt. This file contains a list of all file base names (no paths, one per line) that exist in the project, but some names are repeated. You want to find out how many times each unique file name occurs.

Your task is to generate a frequency count of each unique file name present in /home/user/dev_project/filenames.txt. The output must be written to /home/user/dev_project/filename_counts.txt.

The format of filename_counts.txt must be: each line contains the count, followed by a single space, then the file name. The lines must appear in ascending lexical order by the file name. For example:

2 main.py
3 README.md
7 test_utils.py

Make sure there are no leading or trailing spaces on any line, and only a single space between the count and file name. Save your output to /home/user/dev_project/filename_counts.txt. The automated test will check that the counts and sorting are correct and that the output format matches this example exactly.
